scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: At the end of July, the long-awaited lab trip day finally arrived. The M1GP presentation venue, held at a seaside resort hotel, was filled with excitement from the lab members.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: It’s finally Megumi’s turn to present… The travel SNS app we built together. I wonder if she’s nervous.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: We’ve stayed up late every day, fixing bugs one by one... Her growth has truly amazed me.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: And today… after the BBQ, I’ve made up my mind. I’m going to tell Megumi how I feel. No more hesitation.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: Now then, {{playerName}} and Megumi-san, please begin your presentation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! We’ve developed a travel SNS app called “TravelConnect” exclusively for our lab members!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi… she looks so confident. I remember how nervous she used to be, and now she’s grown so much.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: With this app, you can post travel photos, share recommended spots, and even make travel plans together with everyone!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The audience nodded in admiration at Megumi’s fluent presentation.

scenarios.speaker: Momo
scenarios.text: Whoa~! This looks super easy to use! And the UI is so beautiful!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you so much♪ We faced a lot of challenges during development, but thanks to {{playerName}}-senpai’s support, I was able to relearn the basics!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi… she mentioned me. But honestly, she’s the one who worked so hard.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: That was a wonderful presentation. Now, let’s move on to the M1GP results...

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: This year’s M1GP winners are... {{playerName}} and Megumi! Congratulations!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Applause filled the venue. Megumi’s eyes sparkled with joy.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: We did it! We really won, {{playerName}}-senpai!!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Congratulations, Megumi! It’s all thanks to your hard work!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: It’s all because of you, {{playerName}}-senpai! I never could’ve done it alone!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: After the M1GP presentations ended, the traditional evening BBQ party began. The ocean breeze blew gently as everyone celebrated their victory.

scenarios.speaker: IkeN
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan, that was amazing! I remember when you first joined, you didn’t even know how to program. You’ve grown so much!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you♪ I really didn’t know anything at first… but {{playerName}}-senpai taught me so kindly.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Thinking back to when Megumi first joined… I was nervous just talking to her. Now being with her feels so natural.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Do you remember our first conversation, {{playerName}}-senpai? I gave you that Yuba manjuu souvenir.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Of course I remember. From that moment, your kindness has always comforted me.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Back then, I thought you were someone so distant... but now, being this close and celebrating together makes me so happy.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: She feels the same way… This is my chance. Time to be brave.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Megumi… if it’s okay, could we have a little time to talk alone later?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Huh…? Of course! Where shall we talk?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Want to take a walk by the beach? There’s something I want to tell you.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: While the BBQ carried on, {{playerName}} and Megumi quietly headed toward the beach. The moonlight glistened on the waves as the sound of the sea gently echoed.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Megumi, without saying a word, seemed to already know what this was about, her expression slightly nervous.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai… what did you want to talk about?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Alright, time to say it straight like a man!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Please enter your confession line

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: You confessed your feelings to Megumi...
